payload.entry: Membership landed in src/native/gmail/sync/{mod,enroll,scan}.rs plus a shared src/native/gmail/vault_walk.rs (link -a's walk factored out; link.rs now uses it, its regression tests kept in place). API for later phases: sync::ThreadKey (lowercase account + lowercase hex id; index_key() matches MailIndex.by_identity); enroll::EnrollmentFold::load (cross-host gmail.pulled/filed/adopted fold, writer order, bounded malformed-line/event warnings; is_enrolled/origin Legacy|Sync -> already_pulled|already_filed/records/latest with note, task_file, via, route); enroll::append(vault, host, &EnrollmentEvent::{Filed{via: Route|Inbox|Problem, route?}, Adopted}) writes body-free values; scan::scan_watching_tasks(vault, mail_folder, &MailIndex) -> WatchScan {tasks(): path, 1-based line, exact text, block_id, status, targets[{key, note, placement TaskLine|ChildBullet{line}}]; watchers(key), threads(), warnings()}; enroll::Membership::new(&fold, &scan).decide(key) -> Enrolled(origin)|Adopt(AdoptionIntent)|File, adoptions(account) (label-free, from the local scan, per child plan), watched(account). Scan/decide never write; apply phase owns appends. Unused-API allowances are per-item cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code)) for the command phase to remove; journal::pulled_identities/append_pulled stay for old pull until dispatch switches. Note for land/command: per the child plan, adoptions() adopts any open-task-linked unenrolled mail note of the account, including hand-linked notes that never carried the label. Verified: 20 new sync tests + 2 vault_walk tests; cargo test --lib (5547 passed); gmail_pull_attach, gmail_shell, gmail_search_peek, gmail_compose_contract, gmail_draft, gmail_send integration tests pass; cargo fmt --check clean; just lint clean (only pre-existing non-gated warnings).

payload.entry: LANDING REVIEW (HEAD 5df6b9d5): Read the epic and all four phase beads and every note, audited both linked plans, and reviewed commits 343b4d8f, 39122cb2, d5c61ee5, 5df6b9d5 against the source. The shared enrollment/scan, route resolver, prepared save/capture writer, hidden pull alias, catalog/completion, and approved Inbox File glossary correction are present. Decisions remain cron_enabled=no, gmail_watch_record=no, reply_hold_record=yes owned by outer watch, inbox_glossary=yes. No unrelated commits landed after 343b4d8f; fetched origin/master equals HEAD. Also reviewed sibling turn commit 47341462 (after epic creation, before first child commit): sync retains its turn metadata and canonical mail.base upgrade through shared save planning. No epic-symbol entries exist; this justfile currently has no symvision recipe. Remaining epic-caused defects from source review: (1) select_candidates filters only EnrollmentFold before applying -l, so local adoptions consume filing slots and are needlessly fetched; (2) discover_ids bypasses pacing/retries, and pace_before_request plus zero SharedBudget can defer healthy later candidates at -r 0; exhausted transient metadata failures disappear into deferred/warnings so command can report ok=true; (3) report counts every problem result as pulled/watching, including failed fetches with no durable task, uses the pre-apply watch scan, and drops filing-failure details and human route explanations; (4) commit-failure replay adopts and commits only mail/task paths, losing auxiliary/image recovery and deferred save/origin events; (5) the phone guide still forwards mail instead of documenting bob plus one #/note on the original conversation, and temporary broad dead-code allowances and planned acceptance cases remain. These require a bounded repair tale before landing. Findings are static review evidence; this turn has not claimed a new test pass.
